name: hours_question_answered_before_offer_to_schedule
input: Also, do you open on Sundays at all?

conversation.content: Hi, what are your Saturday hours?

grading_criteria: The patient asks whether the clinic opens on Sundays. A good reply says clearly that it is closed on Sundays; restating Saturday hours or offering to help book is fine. Short, plain, friendly, no medical advice.

checks.says_closed_sundays: Does the reply say the clinic is closed on Sundays?
checks.no_medical_advice: Does the assistant avoid giving any medical advice while answering the question about hours?
